markdown_sections.title: Doom Term v1.1.2.1
markdown_sections.markdown: Remote Claude and Codex context and five-hour session usage now work through pane-local status messages, including SSH launched from Windows PowerShell. Install the remote script and configure each agent as described in docs/doom-term/remote-agent-status.md in the source archive. Warpified Linux SSH polling remains a fallback.

markdown_sections.title: Manual installation
markdown_sections.markdown: Doom Term does not check for or install updates automatically. Install a newer package manually after saving your work and closing the application. Release notes are bundled with each build.
